chunks: Apart from Him. Contrive against me as much as you like, and give me no respite.
ai.seo_question: What does Hud (AS) mean when he tells his people to 'contrive against me' in Surah Hud?
ai.summary: In this verse, Prophet Hud (AS) challenges his people to mobilize all their forces, asserting that their collective plotting is ultimately directed against Allah, who is fully aware of their schemes. The phrase 'thum la nunzirun' (then you will not be reprieved) underscores the certainty of divine retribution, a key theme in Surah Hud where prophets warn their communities of imminent destruction due to their arrogance and rejection of monotheism.
